title: Jesse's France trip and the Before Sunset synchronicity

tellings.quote: and so the next day on a whim I book a trip to France and I end up being there for the whole summer and in Paris I end up dating a girl

plain: Jesse Michels says that one day, on a whim, he booked a trip to France, stayed the whole summer, and ended up dating a girl in Paris. He links this to Before Sunset, a film by the director Richard Linklater about a romance in Paris. Michels tells it from his own life, in a talk about synchronicities and prophetic dreams, as an example of life matching a story in a way that feels meant.
